package scenarionet

import (
	"context"

	syncsender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	roomlogic "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/room"
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/scenariorules"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
)

// Command 是房间玩法（回合 PvP、合作）的接入：RoomID 是房间唯一号（与 room 自带协议同一口径），经 room.EntityID 换成
// Room 的 Entity ID，客户端不能把别的种类的 Entity ID 当房间交给 Sender。操作者取自鉴权会话，连接标识取自服务端 Session
// （room.ConnectionKey，不能从 PB 里取）。Kind "reconnect" 转 room 的 RoomReconnect（Robot 只有这一条消息；真实客户端直接发 RoomReconnect），
// 其余转本玩法的多实体命令 [Room, Player]，代际与连接由持锁 handler 交给 room 核对。
func Command(ctx context.Context, engine *nest.NestMgr, session gateway.Session, request *pb.ScenarioCommandRequest) (Reply, error) {
	player := session.Principal().PlayerID
	room, err := roomlogic.EntityID(request.RoomID)
	if err != nil {
		return Reply{}, err
	}
	connection, err := roomlogic.ConnectionKey(session)
	if err != nil {
		return Reply{}, err
	}
	if request.Kind == "reconnect" {
		snapshot, err := syncsender.NewRoomReconnectSender(engine).Sync_RoomReconnect(ctx, room, player, request.Epoch, connection)
		return Reply{Epoch: snapshot.Epoch}, err
	}
	command := rules.Command{Seq: request.Seq, Revision: request.Revision, Kind: request.Kind, Choice: int(request.Choice)}
	result, err := syncsender.NewScenarioSender(engine).MultiSync_ScenarioCommand(ctx, room, player, request.Epoch, connection, command)
	return Reply{Result: result}, err
}
